industry_signals.title: Specialty retail margin compression — sector-wide
industry_signals.summary: Specialty retailers reporting 80-150bp YoY margin compression FY2025; drivers include digital marketing inflation, return logistics costs, e-commerce shipping, and markdown depth. Apex's 130bp compression is in the worst quartile of peer set.

industry_signals.title: Activist investors targeting mid-market specialty retailers
industry_signals.summary: Multiple activist disclosures in mid-market specialty retail in last 6 months. Stoneridge Capital Partners disclosed Apex position February 2026 (4.8%). Pattern: pressure for cost discipline, board refresh, capital allocation discipline.

industry_signals.title: Customer Data Platform consolidation — Treasure Data acquisition rumor
industry_signals.summary: Industry chatter about Treasure Data potential acquisition by larger martech/data firm. Status unclear; not announced. Could affect long-term roadmap stability.
industry_signals.caveats: Rumor; not verified. Tracking; if announced, will affect BAFO.

industry_signals.title: Cisco-Splunk integration roadmap clarification
industry_signals.summary: Cisco published Splunk integration roadmap February 2026. Continued investment in Splunk Cloud confirmed. Pricing model expected to transition to Cisco enterprise discount structure over 24-36 months.

industry_signals.title: Federal AI legislation (APRA) progress
industry_signals.summary: American Privacy Rights Act (APRA) advanced to House Energy and Commerce committee Q1 2026; bipartisan support but sectoral lobbying continues. Earliest passage 2027. Federal preemption of state privacy laws is the open question.

industry_signals.title: FTC AI rulemaking proposed
industry_signals.summary: FTC announced proposed rulemaking on AI in commerce February 2026. Scope: deceptive AI practices, automated decisions affecting consumers, AI-assisted dark patterns. Comment period through July 2026.
relevance_to_programs: AI Governance Council policy review needed

industry_signals.title: Generative AI in retail customer service — peer adoption signals
industry_signals.summary: 5 specialty retail peers announced gen AI customer service deployments in FY2026 Q1; reported containment improvements 8-15 percentage points. Mixed CSAT outcomes (some positive, some negative).
industry_signals.caveats: Vendor-curated case studies overstate consistency; actual range of outcomes wider than reported

industry_signals.title: Demand forecasting platform vendor consolidation — Blue Yonder + Microsoft
industry_signals.summary: Microsoft acquired Blue Yonder February 2026; integration roadmap announced. Implications for Apex's longlist (Blue Yonder is on the longlist for apex-forecast-2026).

industry_signals.title: Retail e-commerce returns rates — industry-wide spike
industry_signals.summary: Apparel return rates climbed industry-wide FY2025; average e-commerce apparel return rates now 22-28% (vs 18-22% prior). Drivers: changed customer expectations, free-return norms, fit/sizing AI under-deployed.

industry_signals.title: Snowflake pricing model evolution
industry_signals.summary: Snowflake announced new commit tiers and Snowflake Cortex pricing structure February 2026. Apex's renewal in November 2026 will negotiate against new structure.

peer_benchmarks.ams_run_rate_pct_total_it_specialty_reta: 16% median (Apex 17%; slightly above; consolidation likely brings to 12% by FY2027)
peer_benchmarks.forecast_accuracy_mape_specialty_retail: 21% median at SKU-store-week (Apex 28.4%; below median; modernization rationale)
peer_benchmarks._source: Peer set: 12 mid-market specialty retailers; data from public filings + industry studies; FY2025 unless noted
